(there will be no bulletin on 1st november) parish open morning on sunday past, our parish had an open morning in the parish hall to highlig ht the wonderful work of the many volunteer groups in our parish. this was a great opportunity for parishioners to meet the groups and the volunteers who run them and to find out more about the services they offer the parish. check out more photos on our facebook page: facebook.com/stbrigidsparishbelfast date for your diary our advent day of reflection will be on saturday 28th november 2026. title: advent – the awakening heart venue: st brigid’s parish hall, derryvolgie avenue, belfast time: 2- 4.30pm facilitator: rev dr ruth patterson all are welcome. table quiz! who?st brigid's one world group why? raise money for projects in developing countries when? friday 23rd october at 7.45pm where? st bride's parish hall - bring your own refreshments how? to book a table or donate a ballot prize- call kevin on

st. brigid’s apostolic work annual collection the apostolic work has celebrated over 100 years and st brigid’s as part of the diocese of down and conor has supported missionaries and their work overseas. its objectives are to share in the missionary apostolate of the church by prayer, supplying material requirements and financial aid in the developing world. in many poorer parishes in africa, asia and latin america it is missionaries who are on the front line. these women and men do so much with poor communities long before and long after any emergencies. they desperately need your help. a collection will take place after each mass this weekend 17th and 18th october. if you are in a position to help you can donate by a single payment or set up a standing order and credit apostolic work, account no: 00067017 at a. i. b sort code: 93-80-92 if you are a tax payer and wish to gift aid your donation please insert your name house number and post code in the reference box when making your payment. cheques made payable to apostolic work. further information available from thérèse o’reilly through the parish office. we are appealing for your generous support. the mission to love one another continues. november - month of the holy souls during november, masses will be offered for those whose names are included in the november lists of the dead. envelopes and lists will be available in the porch from this weekend. please leave completed envelopes in the box provided.
